title: Andrei-Tiberiu Pantea
text:
I am a first year PhD student between École Polytechnique and EDF. I work on machine learning for time-series forecasting, with a particular interest in in-context learning (ICL) and explainability.
This webite is where I try to organize ideas that survive my notebooks, keep a record of research as it develops, and write about questions that I have. I’ve started writing on this website on 30.10.2026, so it still has to catch up with the work I’ve done until now, which is an amazing opportunity to re-think all the experiments! :)
